A FIELD GUIDE TO FOOLING AROUND

Start a chain reaction.

Drop a marble, line up a few dominoes, bounce off a spring, and try to ring the bell. Or invent something completely pointless.

  1. Make it yours. Drag parts from the box, or click to add. Select a part to rotate, duplicate, or remove it.
  2. Set it in motion. Hit “Let it roll!” Gravity does the rest. Click a marble during a run to give it a nudge.
  3. Tinker. Repeat. Pause to inspect, or Reset to return every part to its starting spot.
